## Shinywidgets end cards

Shinywidgets videos now close with “Use the <package> integration in Shiny apps using” followed by the white and mint wordmark from the [shinywidgets documentation](https://posit-dev.github.io/py-shinywidgets/guide/why/). The card works in portrait and landscape and links to the package site.

Set `outro.widget` to the featured package's display name. The gallery starter fills it in from the episode metadata. Gallery episodes keep their spoken closing line, and the card includes an install command only when you provide one.
